hud.magicmadness.radial.aim_hint: Move mouse to aim • Release [%s] to cast
config.magicmadness.title: Magic Madness
config.magicmadness.choice.pick: Which spell settings do you want to customize?
config.magicmadness.choice.client.desc: Only for you: spell camera feedback, 3D spell visuals, radial HUD and spell audio.
config.magicmadness.choice.server.desc: For the whole world: global spell rules and Fireball balance.
config.magicmadness.choice.server.defaul: Main menu: customize default world spell settings.
config.magicmadness.choice.server.allowe: Allowed: you are the world host or server owner.
config.magicmadness.choice.server.locked: Locked: only the server owner or host may open server spell settings.
config.magicmadness.expand.desc: Unfold every section on this page.
config.magicmadness.collapse.desc: Fold every section on this page shut.
config.magicmadness.defaults.desc: Reset all spell settings on this tab to default. Click Apply or Save to store.
config.magicmadness.apply.desc: Save every change across all spell tabs without closing the screen.
config.magicmadness.steps: Hold Shift for 10 steps at once.
config.magicmadness.server_decides: Locked: only the world host or a listed server owner may open and change server spell settings.
config.magicmadness.world_help: Server spell settings: synced to everyone in this world. Hover any setting to inspect its details.
config.magicmadness.client_help: Client spell settings: stored locally for your own game across all worlds. Hover any line to read what it does.
config.magicmadness.denied: Only the host or a listed server owner may change the server spell settings.
config.magicmadness.client.cameraShake.d: How hard your view shakes from Fireball impacts and explosions (1 = default, 0 = never).
config.magicmadness.client.screenFlash.d: How bright the screen flashes when a Fireball explodes near you.
config.magicmadness.client.particleAmoun: How many particles spells spawn: sparks, embers, flames and smoke.
How much 3D detail Fireball cores, flame ribbons and fire tongues use.
config.magicmadness.client.ashDisintegra: Disintegrate defeated enemies into rising embers and ash when killed by Fireball.
config.magicmadness.client.hudOpacity.de: Opacity of the in-game Spell Radial Menu and cooldown HUD.
config.magicmadness.client.showCooldownN: Show exact remaining cooldown seconds on the radial menu and HUD.
config.magicmadness.client.killConfirm.d: Flick a red cross around your crosshair when you defeat an enemy with a spell.
config.magicmadness.client.spellVolume.d: Volume multiplier for spell casting, flight and explosion sounds.
config.magicmadness.general.damageMultip: Multiplies the damage of every spell in this world (1 = default, 0 = no damage).
config.magicmadness.general.cooldownMult: Multiplies the cooldown of every spell in this world (1 = default, 0 = no cooldowns).
config.magicmadness.general.knockbackMul: Multiplies knockback and push force of spells (1 = default, 0 = none).
config.magicmadness.general.rangeMultipl: Multiplies the arc range of spells.
config.magicmadness.general.radiusMultip: Multiplies the explosion blast radius of spells.
Whether destructive spells may break blocks in the world.
config.magicmadness.general.maxBlockHard: Hardest block material that spells are allowed to break.
config.magicmadness.general.friendlyFire: Whether area-of-effect spells can damage allied players.
config.magicmadness.general.fireball.des: Whether the Fireball spell can be cast in this world.
config.magicmadness.fireball.directDamag: Direct Fireball hit damage before explosion splash.
config.magicmadness.fireball.splashDamag: Explosion splash damage dealt to nearby enemies.
config.magicmadness.fireball.burnSeconds: How long hit targets burn in seconds.
config.magicmadness.fireball.igniteBlock: Whether Fireball explosions set a 3x3 area on fire.
config.magicmadness.fireball.cooldownTic: Cooldown before Fireball can be cast again (100 ticks = 5.0s).
config.magicmadness.fireball.rangeBlocks: Distance in blocks the weighted Fireball arc covers before hitting the ground (default: 10 blocks).
Downward gravity pull per tick that curves the Fireball downward in an arc.
config.magicmadness.fireball.waterExting: Whether Fireball fizzles into a steam cloud upon hitting water.
config.magicmadness.general.lightning.de: Whether the Lightning spell can be cast in this world.
config.magicmadness.lightning.section.st: Sky Bolt Strike, AoE Shockwave & Chain Lightning
config.magicmadness.lightning.strikeDama: Direct lightning bolt strike damage dealt to the primary target.
config.magicmadness.lightning.shockDamag: Electric shockwave damage dealt to enemies around the impact.
config.magicmadness.lightning.shockRadiu: Ground electric shockwave radius in blocks.
config.magicmadness.lightning.chainDamag: Damage dealt per chain lightning jump to nearby enemies.
config.magicmadness.lightning.chainRange: Maximum distance in blocks a chain lightning arc can jump between targets.
config.magicmadness.lightning.maxChainsC: Maximum number of chain lightning jumps in clear weather.
config.magicmadness.lightning.maxChainsR: Maximum number of chain lightning jumps during rain or thunderstorms.
config.magicmadness.lightning.cooldownTi: Cooldown before Lightning can be cast again (140 ticks = 7.0s).
config.magicmadness.lightning.rangeBlock: Maximum target lock range in blocks (default: 24 blocks).
config.magicmadness.lightning.chargeTick: Ticks the sky-rune locks onto the target before the bolt strikes (8 ticks = 0.4s).
config.magicmadness.lightning.knockbackL: Upward vertical launch force when struck by Lightning.
config.magicmadness.general.wind_gust.de: Whether the Wind Gust spell can be cast in this world.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.section.ga: Gale Cone Knockback, Lift & Projectile Deflection
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.gustDamage: Light wind-slash damage dealt to targets inside the gust cone.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.pushStreng: Massive horizontal gale knockback force that blasts enemies backward.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.liftStreng: Upward vertical launch force applied to enemies caught in the gust.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.recoilBoos: Self air-jump and fall-cushion boost when casting Wind Gust in mid-air.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.reflectPro: Whether Wind Gust blasts incoming arrows and projectiles back in your aim direction.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.cooldownTi: Cooldown before Wind Gust can be cast again (70 ticks = 3.5s).
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.rangeBlock: Maximum reach of the Wind Gust cone in blocks (default: 10 blocks).
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.coneHalfAn: Half-angle spread of the Wind Gust storm cone in degrees.
config.magicmadness.wind_gust.section.kn: Low Damage, Massive Gale Knockback & Projectile Reflection
